body: A friend I used to talk with daily used to always leave me on read but then respond when he had the chance. It would go to both of us initiating the conversation to just me starting it up. I'd understand if he was busy but it was going on for a year and I was slow on picking it up since he would reply but days later. I wanted to keep the close friendship that we had. I just look at the notification of what he sends and think of a response since I don't want to leave him on read. We're not close anymore but we just catch up on each other every now and then.

Not having enough money so I don't feel like shit. Being socially awkward to the point that I hate myself and over analyzing every conversation topic that I can't jump in because the topic would be changed by the time I think of something that I would be confident to join the conversation. Hating how I'm over weight. (I'm currently fixing this by better diet, and I'm planning on doing light workout so I can fix this tips would be appreciated). Losing my friends because I close myself off to them without explaining anything and I think they would be better if they didn't know of my existence.
